description: He spends half a million a month on Meta ads — and shared two game-changing tips 👀 I asked this guy how much he spends on Meta ads. He said: “About 400–500K a month.” 😳 Then he shared two tips every advertiser should steal: “1️⃣ Add a custom column for GPT — Gross Profit per Transaction. It’s AOV minus CPA, and it’s way more useful than ROAS.” That metric alone can completely change how you see performance. “2️⃣ Take your best-performing ads and make small creative iterations.” Progress through iteration. Get 1% better every day — that’s how you scale to millions. Would your ads perform better if you measured profit instead of ROAS? 👇 Comment “SCALE” if you want to apply to work with me 1:1 and learn how to build ad systems that actually scale. 🚀
